        OPERATOR_METHOD_NAMES = %i[+ - * / % ** == === != < <= > >= << >> [] []=].freeze

        def self.dispatch_range_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_range_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def self.dispatch_comment_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_comment_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def self.dispatch_dig_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_dig_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          prepare_dig_chain_investigation(node)
          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:offense_range] = range
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

          [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          return false unless usable_argument_list?(arguments)

          catalog_chain_arguments(arguments)
          forwarded_args_in_invalid_position?
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          @dig_chain_state[:offense_range] = range
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          replacement = build_collapsed_dig_call(arguments)
          message = format_collapsed_dig_message(replacement)

          add_offense(range, message: message) do |corrector|
            apply_collapsed_dig_correction(corrector, node, range, replacement)
          end
        end

        def range_between(start_pos, end_pos)
          execute_range_query(:range_between, processed_source.buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
        end
        def prepare_dig_chain_investigation(node)
          @dig_chain_state = {
            receiver: node,
            selector_kind: nil,
            argument_catalog: [],
            combined_arguments: nil,
            offense_range: nil,
            collapsed_replacement: nil,
            relocated_comments: [],
            argument_kind_summary: {},
            hops: [],
            chain_kind: nil,
            has_splat: false,
            has_forwarding: false,
            has_hash: false
          }
          record_chain_receiver(node)
          record_chain_selector_kind
          record_chain_hops(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:chain_kind] = receiver_chain_kind
          @dig_chain_state[:hop_count] = chain_hop_count
          @dig_chain_state[:mixed_safe_navigation] = mixed_safe_navigation?
        end

        def record_chain_receiver(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:receiver] = node
          @dig_chain_state[:receiver_source] = if node.receiver
                                                 node.receiver.source
                                               end
          @dig_chain_state[:outermost_dig] = outermost_dig_node
        end

        def record_chain_selector_kind
          receiver = @dig_chain_state[:receiver]
          loc = receiver&.loc
          kind = if loc.respond_to?(:dot) && loc.dot
                   dot_source = loc.dot.source
                   if safe_navigation_dot?(dot_source)
                     :safe_navigation
                   elsif dot_source == '.'
                     :dot
                   elsif double_colon_dot?(dot_source)
                     :double_colon
                   else
                     :other_dot
                   end
                 elsif loc.respond_to?(:selector) && loc.selector
                   :selector_only
                 else
                   :unknown
                 end
          @dig_chain_state[:selector_kind] = kind
        end

        def record_chain_hops(node)
          hops = []
          current = node
          seen = 0
          while current && dig_call_shape(current)[:dig] && seen < 100
            hop = describe_dig_hop(current)
            hop[:position] = seen
            hop[:terminal] = current.receiver.nil? || !dig_call_shape(current.receiver)[:dig]
            hops << hop
            current = current.receiver
            seen += 1
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:hops] = hops
          @dig_chain_state[:first_hop] = hops.first
          @dig_chain_state[:last_hop] = hops.last
          @dig_chain_state[:safe_hop_count] = hops.count { |hop| hop[:safe] }
          @dig_chain_state[:colon_hop_count] = hops.count { |hop| hop[:colon] }
          @dig_chain_state[:total_hop_args] = hops.sum { |hop| hop[:arg_count] || 0 }
          @dig_chain_state[:multiline_hops] = hops.any? { |hop| hop[:multiline] }
        end

        def mixed_safe_navigation?
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          kinds = hops.map { |hop| hop[:safe] }.uniq
          kinds.size > 1
        end

        def chain_hop_count
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          hops.size
        end

        def outermost_dig_node
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops]
          if hops && !hops.empty?
            hops[-1][:node]
          else
            @dig_chain_state[:receiver]
          end
        end

        def collapsed_argument_count
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          if catalog && !catalog.empty?
            catalog.size
          elsif @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments]
            @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments].size
          else
            0
          end
        end

        def catalog_chain_arguments(arguments)
          entries = []
          arguments.each_with_index do |argument, index|
            entries << describe_argument_entry(argument, index)
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] = entries
          argument_kind_summary
          @dig_chain_state[:has_splat] = splat_like_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:has_forwarding] = forwarding_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:has_hash] = hash_or_kwargs_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_argument_count] = collapsed_argument_count
        end

        def forwarded_args_in_invalid_position?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          return false unless catalog

          index = catalog.index { |entry| entry[:kind] == :forwarded_args }
          index && index < (catalog.size - 1)
        end

        def usable_argument_list?(arguments)
          return false unless arguments

          arguments.any?
        end

        def argument_kind_summary
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          summary = Hash.new(0)
          catalog.each do |entry|
            summary[entry[:kind]] += 1
            summary[:literal] += 1 if entry[:literal]
            summary[:forwarding] += 1 if entry[:forwarding]
            summary[:splat] += 1 if SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(entry[:kind])
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:argument_kind_summary] = summary
        end

        def splat_like_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(entry[:kind]) }
        end

        def forwarding_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| entry[:forwarding] }
        end

        def hash_or_kwargs_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| %i[hash kwargs].include?(entry[:kind]) }
        end

        def receiver_chain_kind
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          if hops.any? { |hop| hop[:safe] }
            :safe
          elsif hops.any? { |hop| hop[:colon] }
            :constant
          else
            kind = @dig_chain_state[:selector_kind]
            case kind
            when :safe_navigation
              :safe
            when :dot
              :plain
            when :double_colon
              :constant
            when :selector_only
              :implicit
            else
              :unknown
            end
          end
        end

        def build_collapsed_dig_call(arguments)
          sources = argument_source_list(arguments)
          joined = sources.join(', ')
          replacement = case receiver_chain_kind
                        when :safe, :plain, :constant, :implicit, :unknown
                          "dig(#{joined})"
                        else
                          "dig(#{joined})"
                        end
          @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] = replacement
          replacement
        end

        def argument_source_list(arguments)
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          if catalog && !catalog.empty? && catalog.size == arguments.size
            catalog.map { |entry| entry[:source] }
          else
            arguments.map { |argument| argument_source_for_collapse(argument) }
          end
        end

        def format_collapsed_dig_message(replacement)
          stored = @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] || replacement
          format(MSG, replacement: stored)
        end

        def apply_collapsed_dig_correction(corrector, node, range, replacement)
          text = @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] || replacement
          corrector.replace(range, text)
          collect_relocated_comments(node)
          insert_relocated_comments(corrector, node)
        end

        def collect_relocated_comments(node)
          comments = execute_comment_query(:comments_in_range, node, processed_source).to_a
          @dig_chain_state[:relocated_comments] = comments.reverse
        end

        def insert_relocated_comments(corrector, node)
          comments = @dig_chain_state[:relocated_comments] || []
          comments.each do |comment|
            corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
          end
        end
        def describe_argument_entry(argument, index)
          metadata = collect_node_metadata(argument)
          {
            index: index,
            node: argument,
            kind: determine_argument_kind(argument),
            source: argument_source_for_collapse(argument),
            literal: argument_is_literal?(argument),
            forwarding: argument_is_forwarding?(argument),
            location: describe_source_location(argument),
            metadata: metadata,
            splat: metadata[:splat_type],
            send: metadata[:send_type],
            source_length: metadata[:source_length],
            contains_newline: metadata[:contains_newline]
          }
        end


        def collect_node_metadata(node)
          return {} unless node

          type = node.respond_to?(:type) ? node.type : nil
          children = if node.respond_to?(:children)
                       node.children
                     else
                       []
                     end
          child_count = children ? children.size : 0
          child_types = if children
                          children.map { |child| child.respond_to?(:type) ? child.type : child.class.name }
                        else
                          []
                        end
          method_name = if node.respond_to?(:method_name)
                          node.method_name
                        end
          receiver_present = node.respond_to?(:receiver) && !node.receiver.nil?
          arguments = if node.respond_to?(:arguments)
                        node.arguments
                      end
          argument_count = arguments ? arguments.size : 0
          hash_type = type == :hash
          array_type = type == :array
          send_type = CALL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          literal_type = LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          forwarding_type = FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          splat_type = SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          parent = node.respond_to?(:parent) ? node.parent : nil
          parent_type = parent.respond_to?(:type) ? parent.type : nil if parent
          sibling_index = if node.respond_to?(:sibling_index)
                            node.sibling_index
                          end
          source = if node.respond_to?(:source)
                     node.source
                   end
          source_length = source ? source.length : 0
          contains_newline = source ? source.include?("\n") : false
          begins_with_colon = source ? source.start_with?(':') : false
          begins_with_star = source ? source.start_with?('*') : false
          begins_with_amp = source ? source.start_with?('&') : false
          special_form = case type
                         when :forwarded_args
                           :ellipsis
                         when :forwarded_restarg
                           :star_starless
                         when :forwarded_kwrestarg
                           :starstar_starless
                         when :splat
                           :star
                         when :kwsplat
                           :starstar
                         when :block_pass
                           :ampersand
                         when :hash, :kwargs
                           :braces
                         when :array
                           :brackets
                         when :send, :csend
                           :call
                         when :sym, :str, :dstr, :dsym, :xstr
                           :text
                         when :int, :float, :rational, :complex
                           :numeric
                         when :true, :false, :nil
                           :booleanish
                         when :lvar, :ivar, :cvar, :gvar, :const
                           :name
                         when :if, :case, :or, :and
                           :logic
                         else
                           :other
                         end
          nested_calls = if arguments
                           arguments.count do |argument|
                             argument.respond_to?(:type) &&
                               (argument.type == :send || argument.type == :csend)
                           end
                         else
                           0
                         end
          nested_literals = if arguments
                              arguments.count do |argument|
                                argument.respond_to?(:type) &&
                                  LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(argument.type)
                              end
                            else
                              0
                            end
          nested_forwarding = if arguments
                                arguments.count do |argument|
                                  argument.respond_to?(:type) &&
                                    FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(argument.type)
                                end
                              else
                                0
                              end
          operator_method = if method_name
                              OPERATOR_METHOD_NAMES.include?(method_name)
                            else
                              false
                            end
          dig_method = method_name == DIG_METHOD_NAME
          predicate_method = if method_name
                               method_name.to_s.end_with?('?')
                             else
                               false
                             end
          bang_method = if method_name
                          method_name.to_s.end_with?('!')
                        else
                          false
                        end
          assignment_method = if method_name
                                method_name.to_s.end_with?('=')
                              else
                                false
                              end
          {
            type: type,
            child_count: child_count,
            child_types: child_types,
            method_name: method_name,
            receiver_present: receiver_present,
            argument_count: argument_count,
            hash_type: hash_type,
            array_type: array_type,
            send_type: send_type,
            literal_type: literal_type,
            forwarding_type: forwarding_type,
            splat_type: splat_type,
            parent_type: parent_type,
            sibling_index: sibling_index,
            source_length: source_length,
            contains_newline: contains_newline,
            begins_with_colon: begins_with_colon,
            begins_with_star: begins_with_star,
            begins_with_amp: begins_with_amp,
            special_form: special_form,
            nested_calls: nested_calls,
            nested_literals: nested_literals,
            nested_forwarding: nested_forwarding,
            operator_method: operator_method,
            predicate_method: predicate_method,
            bang_method: bang_method,
            assignment_method: assignment_method,
            dig_method: dig_method
          }
        end
        def determine_argument_kind(argument)
          return :unknown unless argument.respond_to?(:type)

          case argument.type
          when :forwarded_args
            :forwarded_args
          when :forwarded_restarg
            :forwarded_restarg
          when :forwarded_kwrestarg
            :forwarded_kwrestarg
          when :splat, :restarg
            argument.type == :splat ? :splat : :restarg
          when :kwsplat, :kwrestarg
            argument.type == :kwsplat ? :kwsplat : :kwrestarg
          when :block_pass
            :block_pass
          when :hash
            :hash
          when :kwargs
            :kwargs
          when :sym
            :literal
          when :str
            :literal
          when :int
            :literal
          when :float
            :literal
          when :rational
            :literal
          when :complex
            :literal
          when :true, :false
            :booleanish
          when :nil
            :booleanish
          when :dstr
            :interpolated
          when :dsym
            :interpolated
          when :xstr
            :interpolated
          when :array
            :composite
          when :regexp
            :composite
          when :pair
            :hash_part
          when :send
            :call
          when :csend
            :call
          when :lvar, :lvasgn
            :reference
          when :ivar, :ivasgn
            :reference
          when :cvar, :cvasgn
            :reference
          when :gvar, :gvasgn
            :reference
          when :const, :casgn
            :reference
          when :begin, :kwbegin
            :compound
          when :if, :case, :when, :or, :and
            :conditional
          when :yield, :super, :zsuper
            :implicit_call
          when :block, :numblock, :lambda

          else
            argument.type
          end
        end

        def argument_is_literal?(argument)
          return false unless argument.respond_to?(:type)

          LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(argument.type)
        end

        def argument_is_forwarding?(argument)
          return false unless argument.respond_to?(:type)

          FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(argument.type)
        end

        def argument_source_for_collapse(argument)
          return '' unless argument

          if argument.respond_to?(:source)
            argument.source
          elsif argument.respond_to?(:loc) && argument.loc.respond_to?(:expression)
            argument.loc.expression.source
          else
            argument.to_s
          end
        end


        def inspect_selector_location(node)
          return {} unless node && node.respond_to?(:loc) && node.loc

          loc = node.loc
          selector = loc.respond_to?(:selector) ? loc.selector : nil
          dot = loc.respond_to?(:dot) ? loc.dot : nil
          begin_token = loc.respond_to?(:begin) ? loc.begin : nil
          end_token = loc.respond_to?(:end) ? loc.end : nil
          operator = loc.respond_to?(:operator) ? loc.operator : nil
          expression = loc.respond_to?(:expression) ? loc.expression : nil
          selector_source = selector ? selector.source : nil
          dot_source = dot ? dot.source : nil
          begin_source = begin_token ? begin_token.source : nil
          end_source = end_token ? end_token.source : nil
          operator_source = operator ? operator.source : nil
          safe_navigation = dot_source == '&.'
          ordinary_dot = dot_source == '.'
          constant_colon = dot_source == '::'
          parenthesized = begin_source == '(' && end_source == ')'
          bracket_call = selector_source == '[]' || selector_source == '[]='
          assignment = if selector_source
                         selector_source.end_with?('=') && selector_source != '==' &&
                           selector_source != '===' && selector_source != '!='
                       else
                         false
                       end
          relative_selector_begin = if selector && expression
                                      selector.begin_pos - expression.begin_pos
                                    end
          relative_selector_end = if selector && expression
                                    selector.end_pos - expression.begin_pos
                                  end
          relative_dot_begin = if dot && expression
                                 dot.begin_pos - expression.begin_pos
                               end
          relative_dot_end = if dot && expression
                               dot.end_pos - expression.begin_pos
                             end
          missing_dot = dot.nil?
          missing_selector = selector.nil?
          expression_line = expression ? expression.line : nil
          expression_column = expression ? expression.column : nil
          expression_last_line = expression ? expression.last_line : nil
          expression_last_column = expression ? expression.last_column : nil
          expression_size = expression ? expression.size : nil
          spans_multiple_lines = if expression_line && expression_last_line
                                   expression_last_line != expression_line
                                 else
                                   false
                                 end
          {
            selector_source: selector_source,
            dot_source: dot_source,
            begin_source: begin_source,
            end_source: end_source,
            operator_source: operator_source,
            safe_navigation: safe_navigation,
            ordinary_dot: ordinary_dot,
            constant_colon: constant_colon,
            parenthesized: parenthesized,
            bracket_call: bracket_call,
            assignment: assignment,
            relative_selector_begin: relative_selector_begin,
            relative_selector_end: relative_selector_end,
            relative_dot_begin: relative_dot_begin,
            selector_line: selector ? selector.line : nil,
            selector_column: selector ? selector.column : nil,
            dot_line: dot ? dot.line : nil,
            dot_column: dot ? dot.column : nil,
            relative_dot_end: relative_dot_end,
            missing_dot: missing_dot,
            missing_selector: missing_selector,
            expression_line: expression_line,
            expression_column: expression_column,
            expression_last_line: expression_last_line,
            expression_last_column: expression_last_column,
            expression_size: expression_size,
            spans_multiple_lines: spans_multiple_lines
          }
        end

        def describe_source_location(node)
          return {} unless node.respond_to?(:loc) && node.loc

          loc = node.loc
          expression = loc.respond_to?(:expression) ? loc.expression : nil
          selector_info = inspect_selector_location(node)
          selector = loc.respond_to?(:selector) ? loc.selector : nil
          dot = loc.respond_to?(:dot) ? loc.dot : nil
          begin_token = loc.respond_to?(:begin) ? loc.begin : nil
          end_token = loc.respond_to?(:end) ? loc.end : nil
          operator = loc.respond_to?(:operator) ? loc.operator : nil
          name_token = loc.respond_to?(:name) ? loc.name : nil
          multiline = if expression && loc.respond_to?(:line)
                        expression.last_line && loc.line && expression.last_line != loc.line
                      else
                        false
                      end
          single_line = expression && loc.respond_to?(:line) ? expression.last_line == loc.line : false
          zero_width = if expression
                         expression.begin_pos == expression.end_pos
                       else
                         false
                       end
          {
            line: loc.respond_to?(:line) ? loc.line : nil,
            column: loc.respond_to?(:column) ? loc.column : nil,
            begin_pos: expression ? expression.begin_pos : nil,
            end_pos: expression ? expression.end_pos : nil,
            last_line: expression ? expression.last_line : nil,
            last_column: expression ? expression.last_column : nil,
            size: expression ? expression.size : nil,
            multiline: multiline,
            single_line: single_line,
            zero_width: zero_width,
            has_selector: !selector.nil?,
            has_dot: !dot.nil?,
            has_begin_token: !begin_token.nil?,
            has_end_token: !end_token.nil?,
            has_operator: !operator.nil?,
            has_name_token: !name_token.nil?,
            selector_begin: selector ? selector.begin_pos : nil,
            selector_end: selector ? selector.end_pos : nil,
            dot_begin: dot ? dot.begin_pos : nil,
            dot_end: dot ? dot.end_pos : nil,
            dot_source: dot ? dot.source : nil,
            selector_source: selector ? selector.source : nil,
            safe_navigation: selector_info[:safe_navigation],
            ordinary_dot: selector_info[:ordinary_dot],
            constant_colon: selector_info[:constant_colon],
            parenthesized: selector_info[:parenthesized],
            bracket_call: selector_info[:bracket_call],
            assignment: selector_info[:assignment],
            relative_selector_begin: selector_info[:relative_selector_begin],
            relative_dot_begin: selector_info[:relative_dot_begin]
          }
        end

        def describe_dig_hop(node)
          shape = dig_call_shape(node)
          location = describe_source_location(node)
          arguments = node.respond_to?(:arguments) ? node.arguments : []
          argument_kinds = arguments.map { |argument| determine_argument_kind(argument) }
          receiver = node.respond_to?(:receiver) ? node.receiver : nil
          receiver_type = if receiver && receiver.respond_to?(:type)
                            receiver.type
                          end
          parent_type = if node.respond_to?(:parent) && node.parent && node.parent.respond_to?(:type)
                          node.parent.type
                        end
          chained_to_dig = if receiver
                             !internal_dig_call?(receiver).nil?
                           else
                             false
                           end
          {
            node: node,
            type: node.type,
            safe: shape[:safe],
            send: shape[:send],
            colon: shape[:colon],
            selector: shape[:selector],
            arg_count: shape[:arg_count],
            argument_kinds: argument_kinds,
            has_splat: argument_kinds.any? { |kind| SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(kind) },
            has_forwarding: argument_kinds.any? { |kind| FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(kind) },
            has_hash: argument_kinds.include?(:hash) || argument_kinds.include?(:kwargs),
            receiver_type: receiver_type,
            parent_type: parent_type,
            chained_to_dig: chained_to_dig,
            line: location[:line],
            column: location[:column],
            last_line: location[:last_line],
            begin_pos: location[:begin_pos],
            end_pos: location[:end_pos],
            multiline: location[:multiline],
            selector_begin: location[:selector_begin],
            selector_end: location[:selector_end],
            dot_begin: location[:dot_begin],
            dot_end: location[:dot_end],
            dot_source: location[:dot_source]
          }
        end

        def dig_call_shape(node)
          empty = { dig: false, safe: false, colon: false, selector: nil, arg_count: 0, send: false }
          return empty unless node
          return empty unless node.respond_to?(:type)

          loc = node.respond_to?(:loc) ? node.loc : nil
          dot = loc && loc.respond_to?(:dot) ? loc.dot : nil
          selector_loc = loc && loc.respond_to?(:selector) ? loc.selector : nil

              length = column.size
            else

            end

                               0
                             else
                               source_buffer.line_range(line_number).begin_pos
                             end
            Parser::Source::Range.new(source_buffer, line_begin_pos + column_index,
                                      line_begin_pos + column_index + length)
          when :contents_range
            node = args[0]
            Parser::Source::Range.new(node.loc.expression.source_buffer,
                                      node.loc.begin.end_pos,
                                      node.loc.end.begin_pos)
          when :range_between
            buffer, start_pos, end_pos = args
            Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
          when :range_with_surrounding_comma
            buffer, range, side = args
            src = buffer.source
            go_left, go_right = range_directions(side)
            begin_pos = compose_move_pos(src, range.begin_pos, -1, go_left, /,/)
            end_pos = compose_move_pos(src, range.end_pos, 1, go_right, /,/)
            Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
          when :range_with_surrounding_space
            range, side, newlines, whitespace, continuations, buffer = args
            src = buffer.source
            go_left, go_right = range_directions(side)
            begin_pos = range.begin_pos
            begin_pos = compose_final_pos(src, begin_pos, -1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_left
            end_pos = range.end_pos
            end_pos = compose_final_pos(src, end_pos, 1, continuations, newlines, whitespace) if go_right
            Parser::Source::Range.new(buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
          when :range_by_whole_lines
            range, include_final_newline, buffer = args
            last_line = buffer.source_line(range.last_line)
            end_offset = last_line.length - range.last_column
            end_offset += 1 if include_final_newline
            range.adjust(begin_pos: -range.column, end_pos: end_offset).intersect(buffer.source_range)
          when :column_offset_between
            processed_source, base_range, range = args
            effective_column_for(processed_source, base_range) - effective_column_for(processed_source, range)
          when :effective_column
            effective_column_for(args[0], args[1])
          when :directions
            range_directions(args[0])
          when :final_pos
            compose_final_pos(*args)
          when :move_pos
            compose_move_pos(*args)
          when :move_pos_str
            compose_move_pos_str(*args)
          when :range_with_comments_and_lines
            processed_source, node = args
            commented = range_union_with_comments(processed_source, node)
            last_line = processed_source.buffer.source_line(commented.last_line)
            end_offset = last_line.length - commented.last_column + 1
            commented.adjust(begin_pos: -commented.column, end_pos: end_offset)

            range_union_with_comments(args[0], args[1])

              begin_pos: [range1.begin_pos, range2.begin_pos].min,
              end_pos: [range1.end_pos, range2.end_pos].max

          end
        end

        def range_directions(side)
          if side == :both
            [true, true]
          else
            [side == :left, side == :right]
          end
        end

        def effective_column_for(processed_source, range)
          if range.line == 1 && processed_source.raw_source.codepoints.first == BYTE_ORDER_MARK
            range.column - 1
          else
            range.column
          end
        end

        def range_union_with_comments(processed_source, node)
          ranges = [node, *processed_source.ast_with_comments[node]].map(&:source_range)
          ranges.reduce do |result, range|
            result.with(
              begin_pos: [result.begin_pos, range.begin_pos].min,
              end_pos: [result.end_pos, range.end_pos].max
            )
          end
        end

        def compose_final_pos(src, pos, increment, continuations, newlines, whitespace)
          pos = compose_move_pos(src, pos, increment, true, /[ \t]/)
          pos = compose_move_pos_str(src, pos, increment, continuations, "\\\n")
          pos = compose_move_pos(src, pos, increment, newlines, /\n/)
          compose_move_pos(src, pos, increment, whitespace, /\s/)
        end

        def compose_move_pos(src, pos, step, condition, regexp)
          offset = step == -1 ? -1 : 0
          pos += step while condition && regexp.match?(src[pos + offset])
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def compose_move_pos_str(src, pos, step, condition, needle)
          size = needle.length
          offset = step == -1 ? -size : 0
          pos += size * step while condition && src[pos + offset, size] == needle
          pos.negative? ? 0 : pos
        end

        def execute_comment_query(operation, node, processed_source, extra = nil)
          case operation
          when :comments_in_range
            start_line = node.source_range.line
            end_line = find_end_line_for(node)
            processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(start_line...end_line)
          when :source_range_with_comment
            begin_pos = begin_pos_with_comment_for(node, processed_source)
            end_pos = end_position_for_node(node, processed_source)
            Parser::Source::Range.new(processed_source.buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
          when :contains_comments
            start_line = node.source_range.line
            end_line = find_end_line_for(node)
            processed_source.each_comment_in_lines(start_line...end_line).any?
          when :comments_contain_disables
            disabled_ranges = processed_source.disabled_line_ranges[extra]
            if disabled_ranges
              node_range = node.source_range.line...find_end_line_for(node)
              disabled_ranges.any? do |disable_range|
                disable_range.cover?(node_range) || node_range.cover?(disable_range)
              end
            else
              false
            end
          when :end_position_for
            end_position_for_node(node, processed_source)
          when :begin_pos_with_comment
            begin_pos_with_comment_for(node, processed_source)
          when :start_line_position
            start_line_position_for(node, processed_source)
          when :find_end_line
            find_end_line_for(node)
          else
            nil
          end
        end

        def end_position_for_node(node, processed_source)
          buffer = processed_source.buffer
          end_line = buffer.line_for_position(node.source_range.end_pos)
          buffer.line_range(end_line).end_pos
        end

        def begin_pos_with_comment_for(node, processed_source)
          first_comment = processed_source.ast_with_comments[node].first
          if first_comment && first_comment.loc.line < node.loc.line
            start_line_position_for(first_comment, processed_source)
          else
            start_line_position_for(node, processed_source)
          end
        end

        def start_line_position_for(node, processed_source)
          processed_source.buffer.line_range(node.loc.line).begin_pos - 1
        end

        def find_end_line_for(node)
          if node.if_type?
            if node.else?
              node.loc.else.line
            elsif node.ternary?
              node.else_branch.loc.line
            elsif node.elsif?
              node.each_ancestor(:if).find(&:if?).loc.end.line
            end
          elsif node.block_type? || node.numblock_type?
            node.loc.end.line
          elsif (next_sibling = node.right_sibling) && next_sibling.is_a?(AST::Node)
            next_sibling.loc.line
          elsif (parent = node.parent)
            if parent.loc.respond_to?(:end) && parent.loc.end
              parent.loc.end.line
            else
              parent.loc.line
            end
          end || node.loc.end.line
        end
      end
    end
  end

# frozen_string_literal: true

RSpec.describe RuboCop::Cop::Style::DigChain, :config do
  it 'does not register an offense for unchained `dig` without a receiver' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      dig
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for `X::dig`' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      X::dig(:foo, :bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for dig chained to something else' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo).bar
      x.bar.dig(:foo)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense when the chain is broken up' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo).first.dig(:bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for dig without arguments' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for chained dig without arguments' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig
      x.dig.dig(:foo, :bar)
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for a hash' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig({ foo: 1, bar: 2 }).dig({ baz: 3, quux: 4 })
    RUBY
  end

  it 'does not register an offense for kwargs' do
    expect_no_offenses(<<~RUBY)
      x.dig(foo: 1, bar: 2).dig(baz: 3, quux: 4)
    RUBY
  end

  context 'with chained `dig` calls' do
    it 'registers an offense and corrects with single values' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects when attached to a chain of non-dig receivers' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.y.z.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.y.z.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with multiple values' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz, :quux)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with safe navigation' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz, :quux)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with safe navigation method chain' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x&.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz, :quux)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x&.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects without a receiver' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz, :quux)
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with `::` instead of dot' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar)::dig(:baz, :quux)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)
      RUBY
    end

    it 'registers an offense and corrects with splat' do
      expect_offense(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo).dig(*names).dig(:bar)
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Use `dig(:foo, *names, :bar)` instead of chaining.
      RUBY

      expect_correction(<<~RUBY)
        x.dig(:foo, *names, :bar)
      RUBY

```ruby
begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.end_pos : 0
```

`hoge&.dig(:a)&.dig(:b)` now corrects to `hoge&.dig(:a, :b)`. All 23 specs in `dig_chain_spec.rb` pass.
